_comment: Named terrestrial analog sites frequently discussed in planetary-analog literature. COORDINATE PROVENANCE: approximate site coordinates supplied by the project authors from general public knowledge. They could NOT be verified against an authoritative gazetteer from the build environment (Wikidata/GeoNames/USGS GNIS were not reachable). They are labelled 'approximate' throughout the app. Terrain values at these points are real Copernicus DEM measurements; only the name-to-coordinate association is unverified.
